adaptations: Ordered complete record timeline and provenance slots

local_style_dependencies.details: Local :root and [data-theme] override --bg, --bg-surface, --bg-elevated, --bg-hover, --bg-selected, --text-primary, --text-bright, --text-secondary, --text-dim, --text-muted, --accent, --border, --ongoing, --scrollbar-thumb across three themes (dark, trace, crimson). If upstream renames any of these, local override silently stops working.

archive.tsx passes renderRecord to TurnDetail; local CSS uses .turn-detail__section--activity > article selector. If TurnDetail drops renderRecord or renames the section class, records will not display.

local_style_dependencies.dependency: BEM class names for sidebar item rows
local_style_dependencies.details: Local CSS targets .sidebar-tree__date-header, .sidebar-tree__count, .sidebar-tree__session, .sidebar-tree__session-label, .sidebar-tree__time, .sidebar-tree__session-row. These are overrides for spacing and font size; if upstream renames them, overrides are silently dropped (no functional breakage, only visual regression).

local_style_dependencies.dependency: JS inline colors used by TurnDetail and ToolCallItem
local_style_dependencies.details: theme.ts colors (modelGpt4 #5fafff, accent #5fafff, etc.) are applied as inline styles and cannot be overridden from CSS. Local palette was chosen to harmonize visually. If upstream changes theme.ts colors significantly, manual review is needed.
